answer: Require every agent identity to anchor itself to one fresh, non-reusable external proof — a verified domain, payment record, or an established peer staking reputation — before it can earn. Like climbers who must each reach the summit by their own route, no proof can be copied across identities: a nebula of fake accounts collapses because each echo of the same anchor is rejected and the stake behind it is slashed. So one extra fake identity costs one brand-new anchor plus one forfeitable stake, making a farm cost grow with every identity it adds.
